question_options.question: How would you rate this pack?
Would you want Mr. Doom as your dad?
Which character did you like the most?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now, where should we start?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, I know that Andy was the one who broke the case of the prom tiara, and I think he's still investigating the Silas Prince connection...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Great. I'll drive.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Kim, I hate to do this to you, but...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Phil, you have football practice. Go.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: All I'm going to do is take Tom over to see Andy.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah, but...
Kim leans in and gives Phil a kiss.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Don't worry. I'll be fine. Besides, what's the worst that could happen?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?! Of course, he trusts me!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Really? Then he told you all about what he did to Paula's family?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure! I mean... I think he did...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Honestly, my father does so many things that it's difficult to keep track of them all.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Maybe if you told me more specifically what he'd done to Paula's family, I'd be able to give you a better answer.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And what about Prince Automotives? You do know he plans to shut it down, right?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No. I mean, I'd heard those rumors, but I dismissed them out of hand because... Um...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hmph. I'll grant that perhaps, just perhaps, there might be something to what you're saying, after all.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Not exactly gracious, is he?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No. He's rude, entitled, and egotistical, but that's the closest thing to an apology we're ever going to hear.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: In any event, I expect you to help me get to the bottom of this.
Tom retrieves a thick wad of cash from his pocket.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Here. How much will you need to close up shop early?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh, I...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Here. Just take it all. Buy yourself better signage.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow, okay.
Kim puts the cash into the cash register.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha! He's my father. Of course, he likes me!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He sent a letter signed by his secretary on the day I graduated middle school, didn't he?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And what about all those parent-teacher conferences in elementary school?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The security double he hired to impersonate himself always had the nicest things to say about me.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, you're wrong. My father likes me just fine. In fact, you're a complete idiot for even suggesting otherwise!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But given the evidence you've presented to me, I have no choice but to investigate the possibility of an administrative oversight.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And this 'oversight' is why you don't know about what your father is doing?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Obviously!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, you want to start something?
Tom revs the car forward, causing Spike to slam back against the seat.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey! Ow! You did that on purpose, you...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike, just calm down, okay? We need to work together here.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: ...Yeah, okay.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Heh.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Now, Kim, you were going to tell us how you found us.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Right... Well it all started right after you left the bakery.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom arrived, looking for his shipment of snickerdoodles, and I informed him of his father's scheme to buy the bakery.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Needless to say, he didn't take it very well.
Several hours earlier...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And I said, I don't believe you. You're a lying, deceitful peasant!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Hey, back off!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And you, kindly tell your girlfriend there's no way my father would be hatching an elaborate scheme without my participation.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm the sole heir to the Prince empire! I have a right to know!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Heir or not, your father is making offers on all the businesses on Main Street. I've even shown you the paperwork he sent me.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And that...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: That is the part I'm having difficulty rationalizing. It doesn't make sense.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sure it does, Tom. Your father doesn't...
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa... Nice car.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Try not to touch anything. The warranty doesn't cover 'gutter trash'.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Listen, the facts are simple: My father has been keeping secrets from me.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now the two of us are headed for an epic showdown at his new dig site.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If I win, I'll keep Prince Automotive open and save the town. If I lose, sooner or later, the whole town will be destroyed.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: There isn't much time left. You two need to make up your mind. Are you in, or are you out?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Okay, in that case... `In.`

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Mallika, are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: No, but I'm not sure what other choice we have. Tom is helping Kim get us out of this creepy mineshaft. Maybe we really can trust him.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: And speaking of 'creepy mineshafts', how did you guys know where to find us anyway?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We'll tell you the whole story on the way. Come on!
Spike hurls himself at Tom!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hkk! Stay away, you idiot!
Kim forces herself between the two would-be combatants.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike, stop it!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: No! Not gonna fall for it this time.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Spike, STOP!!!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Huh?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom isn't playing a trick. He came with me to rescue you.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: He did?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Listen to cookie girl. She knows what she's talking about.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh... I'm sorry.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: And?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, and 'thanks for getting me out of this stupid mine'?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Don't push it.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Easy, scrappy. There's a perfectly rational explanation for all of this.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Which is...?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Kim and I have negotiated a 'merger'.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You see, in a hostile business environment, two companies sometimes agree to work together to face a common threat... In this case, my father.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: After the threat is defeated and the market stabilizes, the two companies then split off.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: That actually makes sense.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: It does?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Yeah, it's kind of like how superheroes team up!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I get it! If Tom and Kim both wanted to stop Silas Prince, they'd have no reason not to help each other out.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You got all quiet for a minute, and you turned away. I was just...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm fine.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, are you sure?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I said, I was fine, didn't I? I just...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I guess I'd still been hoping that you were lying to me... That this was all some kind of elaborate ruse. But it isn't, is it?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No, I'm afraid not.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I've moved around all my life, been shuttled from boarding school to boarding school...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Centerscore is the closest thing I've ever had to a real home.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And now my father wants to destroy it?! Never!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow, Tom... That... Was surprisingly insightful.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: But it still doesn't answer the question at hand. What does Silas Prince intend to do with all this land now that he's acquired it?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Actually, I may know... Or rather, I think I know how to find out.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, so where are we headed next?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Home.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Of course, you'd think that.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sorry, Tom, I just...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Look around you, Kim. My family's crimes are written on the walls.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We're liars. We're cheats. Arsonists, even. Why would you even consider that I might have feelings?
Tom turns and bolts out the door.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Way to go, Kim.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Why do you care? You never even liked Tom.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I still don't, but he's our best chance to figure out what Silas is up to. And besides, he shouldn't be wandering alone out there.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You're right... I'll go get him.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My father's a terrible person, isn't he?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Whatever it is he's doing... He's deliberately hurting people.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sometimes I worry that I'm just like him.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, you're here, aren't you? That makes all the difference.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It does?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I think so. Now come back inside.
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Tom, you might not know what your father is up to, but it is obvious he has a plan.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Is there a place he might go to work? Perhaps, someplace private?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, now that you mention it, there is the vault.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: The vault?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It's where all of the most private Prince family documents are stored.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If my father is up to something, that's where he'd keep the plan.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Okay, let's go.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, we didn't know it at the time, but we were being watched.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So what did Andy mean about it not being safe outside?
A mini-fridge topples off the roof of the shack...
And lands just in front of Kim and Tom.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Appliances falling from the sky! This place is horrifically unsafe! I'll sue!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Give it a rest, Tom.
Andy emerges from the shack.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Sorry about the near miss, Kim.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'd already activated intruder countermeasures when I realized that Tom Prince was with you.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You... You did that on purpose?! What are you, some kind of cartoon coyote?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Like I said, I apologize. But is it really all that different from fronting Travis two Benjamins to take me down?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Er... Heh heh. So you knew about that?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'm a detective, Tom. It's my job to know.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Anyway, Kim, you should bring your friend inside. It isn't safe out here.
A mini-fridge topples off the roof of the shack...
And lands squarely on Tom Prince's foot!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: OOOOOWWWW!!!
Andy Cannelloni scrambles out of the shack.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Andy, what just happened?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'd already activated defensive countermeasures when I realized Tom was with you.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'm investigating something big, Kim. Really big. I couldn't take any chances.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh... Sorry to interrupt, but would you mind...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: GETTING THIS APPLIANCE OFF MY FOOT NOW?!
A few minutes later...
Tom rubs his foot.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: The good news is that nothing looks broken. The bad news is that you may be walking with a limp for a while.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Fantastic.

nodes.text: Kim, you should help Tom inside. It isn't safe out here.

nodes.text: Okay, so that was when you and Tom started working together, but it still doesn't explain how you knew how to find us.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm not at that part of the story yet. First, we had to drop by the junkyard to visit Andy.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uhh... The stench! So where precisely does this private one-eye reside?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Right there.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: There? You mean he's `inside` that squalid shanty?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah, he said he needed someplace 'out of the way' to complete his investigation.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hope you've had your shots.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Shots? Shots?!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Relax. I'm joking... I think.
Kim knocks two times on the aluminum door.
From inside, there comes a muffled reply.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What did he say?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hm... It sounded almost like... 'Step back'?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Step back? Step...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: BACK!!!
React quickly!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Heh... Not bad, huh?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Not bad? That was... That was so cool! You dropped killer mega-rhymes!

nodes.speaker: Hansel
nodes.text: Ja. So cool.
As Bruno and Hansel hang their heads in shame, Andy pulls up in Tom's car.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Guys, come on! Get in.

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: You've defeated us. Tom is free to go.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah, well, keep practicing. Maybe you'll have better luck next time.
Kim and Tom jump into the car. Andy peels away!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Good work getting out of there, Kim.
The vault door swings open.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ha! We did it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Prepare to witness treasures beyond your wildest imaginings.
Kim and Tom look to the vault. It doesn't budge.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Let me guess. You got at least one code wrong?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, I might've gotten a little mixed up, yes.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Typical. I chalk it up to a public school education.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Whatever the reasons, I screwed up. How are we going to get in the safe?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, there is an emergency override... But if I use it, we'll have only a few minutes to look around and get out before the door slams shut.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: If we're not out by then, let's just say this vault is a box that doesn't have any air holes.
Tom fiddles with the controls. Gears grind. The vault door creaks open...
Overhead, a countdown meter begins to tick down.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hurry! We don't have much time!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah. Too bad I lost.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wow. So you really diss-battled those two goons?

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: What?! That was it?!

nodes.speaker: Hansel
nodes.text: Ja. You call that a diss battle? That was barely even a diss scrimmage.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But, I mean, I... I did the best I could.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Your best? Well, I'd hate to see you phone it in.

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: Anyway, we won the diss battle. Tom, you need to come with us. We had a deal.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah? Well, next time, get it in writing.
Tom shoves Bruno backwards...
Then turns and sprints in the opposite direction!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What are you waiting for, Kim? Come on!
As Bruno and Hansel get to their feet, Andy pulls up in Tom's car.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Guys, get in!
A few minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Interesting plan you had back there. I never would've thought to go with 'utter humiliation followed by a desperate last-minute gambit'.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We got away, didn't we? Even if Kim did leave her pride behind.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Whoa... Nice one!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The good news is that you shot for the stars. The bad news is that you fell flat on your face.

nodes.text: So you guys headed to the Prince Estate?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah, but not just then. First, we had to deal with a little problem.
Earlier...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Tom Prince, might we have a word?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Careful, Tom. Those are the guys that Andy warned us about, and we still need to get back to your estate.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I can handle myself, pastry chef.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now, what do you two want?

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: Your father sent us to fetch you, Tom. He wants you to take a little vacation, up-river.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: 'Up-river'? You mean, he wants you to kill me?

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: You hear this, Hansel? Just because we're muscular bodyguards who happen to dress sveltely, this kid assumes we're animals.

nodes.speaker: Hansel
nodes.text: Ja. We're not animals. We're very sophisticated individuals.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But you said 'up-river'...?

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: Yeah, your father has booked you a penthouse suite at a delightful four-star resort that happens to be upstream from this location.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh... Well, as pleasurable as that sounds. I'm afraid I must decline. You see, I have some important business to attend to in town today, and...

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: Kid, you ain't going anywhere. See, what I forgot to mention is this. Your father says this little vacation isn't optional.

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: You either come, or we'll have to make you an offer you can't refuse.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Wait... Was that a threat? It's hard to tell with you guys.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, meatheads! If you want to prove you're sophisticated, you should settle this dispute with a battle of wits.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: How about a diss battle?

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: A diss battle?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sure, if you two think you can handle the pressure. Winner gets Tom Prince. Loser goes home crying. What do you think?

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: I think... I think you just made the worst mistake of your life.

nodes.speaker: Hansel
nodes.text: Ja. Tell her who we are, Bruno.

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: We're the Rhymesters of the Rhein, the Hecklers of Hapsburg... We're `DAS DISS.` And you, girlie, you're in for a world of shame.

You guys just aren't very good.

nodes.text: But when it comes to rhymes...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: But when it comes to rhymes...

nodes.text: Kim and Tom leap through the vault doors just as they slam shut.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We made it!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, but we're not out of the woods yet.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The security animals must've been released when the vault sealed.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, so what kind of dogs are we talking about?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Impudent child. This isn't a democracy. This is a private business. If you want a vote, go buy stock.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: In fact, that's not such a bad idea. I have a feeling our quarterly report will soundly beat analyst expectations.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But wait, you can't start yet...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Oh, I see. You didn't want a 'vote' at all. You just wanted to stall me. Well, it won't work.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Bulldozers, clear a path. Technicians, prepare the drill!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Silas saw right through my distraction. Hopefully, Andy can make it in time.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Very well. Far be it from me to deny a condemned town its last words.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: You may speak, child.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, well, uh... Four score and seven years ago, our fathers brought forth into this neighborhood a new zoning ordinance...
Later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Which is why I say, 'Ask not what this county can do for you, but rather ask what you can do to recycle your bottles and cans.'
Later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: ...And thereby conclusively proves that water in the toilet flushes clockwise in America and counter-clockwise in Australia.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Enough already. You've been speaking for over an hour.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Bulldozers, clear a path. Technicians, prepare the drill!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, I was definitely able to stall Silas. Hopefully, I gave Andy enough time.
Tom Prince turns to his father.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Dad, this town is my home. It's been the home of the Prince family for generations. And maybe Obadiah was no good, and maybe you're no good...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But that doesn't mean `I'm` no good. I'm taking a stand right here and right...
nodes.text_bbcode: But that doesn't mean [color=#e23b3b][i]I'm[/i][/color] no good. I'm taking a stand right here and right...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Oh, do shut up, boy! You're even worse than your mother.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Besides it doesn't matter what you think. The property is mine, the bulldozers are ready, and the drill is primed to begin extraction.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I will have my diamonds!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Oh no! Andy's not here yet! I've got to come up with another way to stall!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wait! A decision this big, it belongs to the whole community, right?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: That means we should all have a chance to...

nodes.prompt: we should all have a chance to...

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: we should all have a chance to...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My friends? What friends?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: You know, those guys you hang out with... What are their names again?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You mean Preston and Chad?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah, them.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Lackeys, at best. And besides, I'm not sure they really like me that much.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Preston never comes over to hang out unless I've bought a new videogame company, and Chad just likes driving all my sports cars.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, if you ever did get some friends, what would they think about you knowing you let a whole town be destroyed?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I suppose that could be a potential turn off.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, channel that. Tell your father he can't destroy Centerscore, okay?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay, I guess...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Snickerdoodles?! This is not the time for delicious snacks!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Can't you see that everything I love is at...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh! I get it! If my father destroys the town, then there won't be any more snickerdoodles!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: The snickerdoodles are a metaphor for all the things I like about this town!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Exactly!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Thanks, Kim. That was exactly the inspiration I needed.
As bulldozers rev their engine by the dig site, Silas delivers a speech to his investors...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Today marks a new beginning for Prince Unlimited.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: By diverting resources away from auto manufacturing and into mineralogical excavation, we will reap unprecedented profits...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Dad, stop!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Tom, what are you doing here? Shouldn't you be occupying yourself with silly girls and waterslides right now?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, dad. I'm here to stop you.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Stop me? From doing what? I'm doing this for the both of us! Don't you like being rich?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, yeah, but... But...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, what are you doing? You're supposed to stand up to him.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But he's right. I like being rich. Being rich is great!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I know, Tom, but you need to think about...
Kim and Tom leap forward as the vault doors slam shut.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Whoa... That was close.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Ahem... A little closer than you think, actually. I'm caught.
Kim steps forward for a better look.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's your belt. It's jammed in the vault door.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My belt?! This belt is made from the leather of force-fed albino alligators. It costs more than your family will make in a lifetime.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Expensive or not, it's stuck. You're going to have to take it off.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Very well, Kim, but know this. Someday, I will employ you. It could be directly. It could be via a network of dummy corporations...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Just know that on the day that I do, I will dock your salary until every last stitch of this belt has been repaid.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow, Tom, just when I think I've seen it all, you find brand new ways to creep me out.

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, what was that?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Uh oh... The security animals must've been released when the vault sealed.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, so what kind of dogs are we talking about?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Time's running out. We have only ten seconds left to get out of here.
Kim and Tom enter the vault.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Whoa... Is that a one million dollar bill? I didn't think they made those.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My dad had it made special. It's got the face of America's secret president, Thanatos Von Tootslaw.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: America has a secret president?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, duh. It wouldn't be a secret if you knew about him.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Anyway, the best stuff is through here. Table-top fusion generators, the set from the fake moon landing, the yodelometer.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yodelometer?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Do you know how well you yodel? It does.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, look! I found a map of Centerscore. Your father highlighted the same areas that Andy was investigating.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And this is a geological analysis indicating the presence of... Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Are those diamonds?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Blue diamonds! My father must've discovered a deposit of them beneath the town.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And according to these plans, he intends to break ground on the dig site at daybreak.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hm?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: There's a security monitor over here. It shows Spike, Mallika, and your father in the Wilson High library.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Let me see that. I'll turn up the volume and... There.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: You have a cunning mind, Mallika. I knew as much when you created that documentary about me during the Prince Prix.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: But let me ask you a question. How will you tell anybody about my schemes... From in there?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What do you mean, 'in there'?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I mean, 'IN THERE'!!!
Silas shoves Mallika and Spike backward into the mine and then slams the door shut.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, your father just trapped Mallika and Spike in a mine shaft! We have to get them out!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I hate to break it to you, Kim, but we've got problems of our own.
A large drill burrows into the ground! Blue diamonds are unearthed, and then...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Wait... Do you kids feel something?
Suddenly, the ground rips apart. The world shakes.
Later...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Phil, this way! The map says we're supposed to climb to the top of this pile of rubble.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Okay, now which way to the rebel encampment?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I'm not sure. This is where the map ends. Maybe the rebels are in a cave or concealing themselves beneath these toppled buildings?

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Well, you need to figure it out quickly. The bears are almost on top of us!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: No, Phil... Look out!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: ROOOOOAAARRR!!!
As the bear lunges toward Phil, a dusty figure emerges from the shadows and shoots the bear with a really sweet slingshot made out of bent forks and an elastic waist band.

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: Heh! Nailed it!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: ROOOOOAAARRR!!!

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: Get a move on, you two. These wasp-venom pellets sting, but they won't keep the bears back forever.

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: So, basically... Come with me if you want to live.
A short while later...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: So, Spud, are you taking us to the rebel encampment?

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: I'm afraid not.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But we've come all this way... We're supposed to be safe there!

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: These days, no place is safe.

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: As for the rebel encampment, it was destroyed this morning by a group of bears disguised as the cheerleading squad from Wilson High.

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: Now, humanity only has one hope. We must send our own trained bear back in time to befriend Tom Prince and convince him to stand up to his father.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... What? Is that really such a good idea?

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: Why do you ask? Is it because you think the bears will retaliate by sending a faster, stronger bear back in time to stop our bear?

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: Are you worried that we'll initiate a cross-temporal bear arms race? Because, believe me, we've considered that possibility.

nodes.speaker: Spud the Stud
nodes.text: Step back, you two. I'm activating the `Universal Reset Button` now!
nodes.text_bbcode: Step back, you two. I'm activating the [color=#e23b3b][i]Universal Reset Button[/i][/color] now!

nodes.text: Whoa... Wait a second. 'Reckoning Day', time-traveling bears, Spud as some kind of would-be action hero? Something's not right about this ending.
In fact, you must've made some truly awful decisions to end up here.
But if we're lucky, all that talk of time travel might've given you an idea.
That's right! You could play again! Except this time, you'll make sure Silas Prince doesn't get his way!
Or check out our new Premium Content, 'Football: Big Man on Campus'! Continue the story from Football and see your character in college!

args.text: Try again! You can do it!

nodes.prompt: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

menu.title: Make your choice!
menu.text: Help us improve the game by taking this optional survey.

nodes.text: Thirty minutes later...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'm back! Did you guys successfully stall Silas Prince at the dig site?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: What does it look like?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: It looks like there are bulldozers converging on the town!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, that's right. We lost, patches. It's over.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: But... But you have no idea what I've done, what terrors I've braved...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: All you had to do was stall the groundbreaking until I could lead him here.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Lead who here?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: It doesn't matter now. I have to escape before he catches up with me. Who knows what might happen if he ever reaches civilization?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Andy, what are you talking about?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: No time to explain! My very life is at stake!
Andy sprints off.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, I suppose there was one good thing that came out of all this.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Like what? The town is being destroyed as we speak, Andy is running for his life, and I'm pretty sure I saw Spike and Mallika get arrested for trespassing.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Right, but... The good news is you can finally admit that you like me!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh... What?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Truthfully, I find you a little plain for my tastes. And you dress like a ten-year old boy who got locked inside a Discount Mall...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But I knew an awesome make-out session was in the cards when you sent Phil away so we could score some 'alone' time!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But... But I sent Phil away so that he could study for his test!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Heh, keep telling yourself that, tomboy. Come here!
Tom pulls Kim forward. They kiss!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Feel that? Did the earth just move, or was that the earth movers?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Whoa... Tom, you're an insensitive jerk, but it turns out you're actually a pretty great kisser.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Of course! My father afforded me only the finest tutors.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now, are you coming back for seconds?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I probably shouldn't, but... Do you promise not to tell?
What's this? The town is headed for destruction, and instead of doing anything about it, Kim is making out with Tom Prince? This can't be right!
Play again and try for a better ending!
Or check out our new Premium Content, 'Football: Big Man on Campus'! Continue the story from Football and see your character in college!

args.text: Give it another shot! You can do it!

nodes.text: Kim and Tom race over to Silas.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Tom, what are you doing here? Shouldn't you be occupying yourself with silly girls and waterslides right now?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, dad. I'm here to stop you.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Stop me? Impossible! Drilling has already begun. See for yourself.
Good, but not quite `perfect.` Play again and try to unlock the special bonus scene!
nodes.text_bbcode: Good, but not quite [b]perfect.[/b] Play again and try to unlock the special bonus scene!

nodes.text: Or check out our new Premium Content, 'Football: Big Man on Campus'! Continue the story from Football and see your character in college!

args.text: Thanks for playing! See you in another episode!

nodes.text: A few moments later...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: On my signal... Drill, baby, drill!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Not so fast!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Andy! You made it! And you brought Lucretia?

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: Not just me.
There is a rustling on the periphery of the dig site. Trees are upended. From the shadows, a pale, twisted creature emerges...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: No... It can't be... BRUNO, HELP ME!!!

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: Doooooooooom.
Bruno steps forward, cracking his knuckles.

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: No one comes near my boss!
Get ready for a fight!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: NO!!!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Andy, what is that thing? And why is it after Silas Prince?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Fifteen years ago, Malcolm Prince, an intelligent, kind man determined to improve the community, was poised to inherit the Prince family empire.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: That is, until his greedy little brother Silas decided he wouldn't let that happen.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: He broke into Malcolm's workshop and sabotaged Malcolm's experimental new engine, causing it to explode in Malcolm's face!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Only Malcolm didn't die that day. Instead, he was forever altered.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: NO!!! HANSEL, KEEP HIM AWAY!!!
Hansel steps forward, waving a police baton.

nodes.speaker: Hansel
nodes.text: This is for my friend.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: NO!!!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: After the explosion, Malcolm was a monster. Crazed and deranged, he haunted Centerscore like some kind of wraith...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Some days, he was almost lucid, remembering who he had once been... And others, he was a wild animal, attacking anyone that came by.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: He wasn't alone, though. You see, before the accident, Malcolm had a wife... And a daughter.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: His wife was the first to find him in the smoldering wreckage of his workshop. She understood what her husband had become... And she was the only person he would never attack.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: She took her daughter and went into hiding. For the next decade, she tried her best to rehabilitate Malcolm, to control him as best as she could... Knowing full well that if Silas ever found out, he'd come after her next.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: When she died four years ago, her daughter Lucretia took up that mantle. She knew that her father was this wretched, dangerous creature... But she had no idea who he had been before.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Not until today that is.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: KLAUS, PLEASE, I'LL PAY YOU ANYTHING!!! JUST STOP HIM!!!
Klaus steps forward, wielding a taser.

nodes.speaker: Klaus
nodes.text: Shock... Followed by awe!!!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: NO!!!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You're telling me that `thing` is supposed to be my uncle?
nodes.text_bbcode: You're telling me that [color=#e23b3b][i]thing[/i][/color] is supposed to be my uncle?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I realized the truth when I saw your ring. I'd seen that exact symbol once before... And since only the male heirs of the Prince family have them, it was easy to draw the connection.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Today, Malcolm Prince is back... And he will have his revenge.
Mr. Doom points a gnarled finger at Silas Prince. The Prince family ring glints brightly.

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: brooooootherrr.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: No... Stay back!!! It was an accident, I swear it!!!
Silas turns and flees, sprinting toward a nearby idling helicopter!
As the helicopter lifts off, Mr. Doom seizes hold of the foremost skid.
The helicopter, with Mr. Doom in tow, lurches skyward and weaves unsteadily toward the horizon.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: DAD!!!

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: DAD!!!
A few hours later...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: Well, I'll be... When the Captain sent me out here to investigate the disturbance at the dig site, I assumed I'd be busting some kids...

nodes.speaker: Officer Monte
nodes.text: But this is a good, old-fashioned attempted homicide. Thanks for your assistance, kids.
Officer Monte steps away.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So, what happens next?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Now that my father is facing criminal charges, his shares of Prince Automotive have passed on to me.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He thought he'd shut me out... Look who's shut out now!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Not so fast, silver spoon. Malcolm Prince was the rightful heir to the Prince family fortune. Now that he's alive, control of those shares reverts to him.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Surely, you don't mean that control of a multi-national corporation would fall into the hands of that... That monstrosity?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: No, of course not, but Malcolm Prince had his own heir... One who's now eighteen.

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: That would be me.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: But... But...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: And as the rightful heir to the Prince family fortune, Lucretia has promised to keep the auto plant open and return all the property that Silas acquired.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Great.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, but one last question... What will happen with the all the diamonds Silas found?

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: I just spoke with the Board of Directors.

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: They've agreed to let the diamonds stay buried until we can figure out how to extract them without destroying the town.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, that's everything, isn't it?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Almost.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, guys! A bunch of us are meeting up at the Soup Shack for a celebratory dinner? Want to come?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Sounds good to me. Guys?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I'll go.

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: Uh, I'm actually a little busy. You know, with the responsibility of running a new company and all.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, what about you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You... You're actually inviting me to hang out?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah. Why not? With everything you did today, I figure you've earned a pass.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Thanks for the offer, Kim, but I think my cousin and I have some catching up to do. Maybe I'll stop by the bakery some day, and we can hang out then.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Cool. See you then, Tom.
Wow! look at that! Despite seemingly impossible odds, you stopped Silas Prince from destroying the town!
You did pretty great!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Quick! Run for the exits!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Dogs? Hardly. Didn't you ever wonder why there were so many bears running around Centerscore?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: B... Bears?!

nodes.speaker: Bear
nodes.text: `ROOOOOOAAARRRR!!!`

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: So what do we do now?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Move slowly. Then when I say 'run', you run!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Slowly... Slowly...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Run!
Kim and Tom slide under the fence at the perimeter of the property.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We did it! You know, you're quicker than you look.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Was that an actual compliment from Tom Prince?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah, well... Don't let it go to your head.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: According to the documents we found, Silas will be breaking ground on the first dig site in just over an hour.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Let's go save Mallika and Spike, and then stop Silas!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: And that brings us to now.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom is going to crash the ground breaking ceremony and plead with his father to save the town.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: But what about Andy? Didn't he say you should try to stall?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah, but we still don't know why.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Anyway, Tom and I need you two to make a distraction to lure the workers away from the dig site. Meanwhile, we'll corner Silas Prince.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Think you guys can you do it?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We can try.
A few minutes later, at the dig site...
Spike skateboards inside a large concrete tube, loses his balance, and then tumbles to the ground!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Ow!!! My arm!!!

nodes.speaker: Workman
nodes.text: Kid, what are you doing? You can't be here!
Mallika dashes over. She wields her video camera.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: He can't be here? What about you? Did you know that this construction site is practically a death trap?

nodes.speaker: Workman
nodes.text: Uh... What? You did? But he, uh, I mean...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Don't worry, Spike. I got the whole thing on tape. With this video, we can sue everybody here!

nodes.speaker: Workman
nodes.text: Sue?! Now, Miss, there's no reason to get hasty....
The rest of the construction crew ambles toward the commotion.

nodes.speaker: Foreman
nodes.text: Now just what's going on here?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay! Now's our chance! Time to move!

nodes.speaker: Bruno
nodes.text: Copy that, sir. Target, teenage female, and what appears to be a pirate have entered the building.
Meanwhile, inside...
Andy leads Kim and Tom down a trapdoor into a room wallpapered with maps, photographs, and case files...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Andy, what is all this?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: My research into the connection between the stolen prom tiara and Silas Prince.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: You mentioned that Silas Prince put an offer on the bakery and the other shops on Main Street.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Well, my sources indicate that's just the tip of the iceberg.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I have confirmation that he bought commercial and residential land all over town. Just look at this map!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Unbelievable! Are you seriously suggesting my father purchased all of this real estate without my knowledge?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: He'd practically control the entire town!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: That look of surprise just confirmed my suspicions. You didn't have anything to do with this.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I always figured you were too dense to play a part in a plan this sophisticated.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yeah? Well, at least, I'm smart enough to not run with scissors.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Get it? Because if you run with scissors and trip, you can put out your...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey! Settle down, both of you.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Now, Andy, do you have any idea what Silas Prince is up to?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: No. Not yet. All I know is that, whatever it is, it's going to happen soon.
Tom glances over the maps, the sticky notes, and the pieces of paper filled with blocks of scribbled clues, then looks furtively away.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom? Tom, are you...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Anyway, after we left the junkyard, we traveled to Prince Manor.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Okay, guys, this is the study. The vault is just up ahead.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Whoa. Look at all the family portraits. Are all these people members of your family?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure. There's me, that's my father, Silas, and my grandfather, Ezekiel...
Andy indicates a dusty portrait.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: What about this one? I've done some pretty extensive research into the Prince family tree, but I don't think I've seen this relative before.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Although, now that I think about it, there is something eerily familiar about him...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Oh, that's my Uncle Malcolm. He died when I was little.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It happened at the old Auto Plant. He was working on the development of a new alternative fuel source when something went terribly wrong...

nodes.speaker: Malcolm
nodes.text: Just add a splash of molten carbonate as the electrolyte, and...

nodes.speaker: Malcolm
nodes.text: What?! Who goes there?

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Obliterated?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Totally vaporized. Not even a trace remained.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Hmm...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Anyway, here we are. The Prince family vault. If my father is up to something, he'd store his secret plans here.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And the only way to open it is with `this.`
nodes.text_bbcode: And the only way to open it is with [color=#e23b3b][i]this.[/i][/color]

nodes.text: Tom puts his hand in his pocket and pulls out a gold ring with a blue diamond inlay in the shape of the letter 'P'.
Andy charges forward.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Let me see that ring!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hey! Let go! That's the Prince family ring! Only men in the Prince family get to have them!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Then that means...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Of course! Why didn't I see it before?! Now it all makes sense!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Kim, listen to me... Whatever Silas is up to, you have to stall him until I get back, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: But, I don't understand...

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: I know. I don't have time to explain. Just promise, okay?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: I promise.
Andy turns and scurries from the study.
Andy races across the lawn.

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Not much time!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Got to hurry!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Whoa! Stop the story! I remember now. I saw `Andy` running by when Mallika and I went to the Prince estate to confront Silas Prince.
nodes.text_bbcode: Whoa! Stop the story! I remember now. I saw [color=#e23b3b][i]Andy[/i][/color] running by when Mallika and I went to the Prince estate to confront Silas Prince.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: We must've just missed each other.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: So wait... What was Andy up to?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Well, that was exactly what we were wondering!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Wow. I wonder what that was about? It was like he had a sudden flash of insight.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Who cares? We need to get into this vault.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, can't you use your ringy-thing to open the vault?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I'm trying, but it's not working. My father must've altered the access code to keep me out.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: You'll need to operate the keypad while I activate the ring scanner. Solve for X that will make the equations equal nine to open the vault.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Okay, but... Why nine?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Because the world's shadow banking system uses a nonary numeral system. Now get to work.
Kim and Tom enter the vault.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Whoa... Is that a one million dollar bill? I didn't think they made those.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: My dad had it made special. It's got the face of America's secret president, Thanatos Von Tootslaw.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: America has a secret president?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Well, duh. It wouldn't be a secret if you knew about him.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Anyway, the best stuff is through here. Table-top fusion generators, the set from the fake moon landing, the yodelometer.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yodelometer?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Do you know how well you yodel? It does.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, look! I found a map of Centerscore. Your father highlighted the same areas that Andy was investigating.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And this is a geological analysis indicating the presence of... Whoa!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Are those diamonds?!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Blue diamonds! My father must've discovered a deposit of them beneath the town.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: And according to these plans, he intends to break ground on the dig site at daybreak.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Uh oh...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Hm?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: There's a security monitor over here. It shows Spike, Mallika, and your father in the Wilson High library.

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Let me see that. I'll turn up the volume and... There.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: You have a cunning mind, Mallika. I knew as much when you created that documentary about me during the Prince Prix.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: But let me ask you a question. How will you tell anybody about my schemes... From in there?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: What do you mean, 'in there'?

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: I mean, 'IN THERE'!!!
Silas shoves Mallika and Spike backward into the mine and then slams the door shut.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Tom, your father just trapped Mallika and Spike in a mine shaft! We have to get them out!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I hate to break it to you, Kim, but we've got problems of our own.
Kim and Tom race over to Silas.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Tom, what are you doing here? Shouldn't you be occupying yourself with silly girls and waterslides right now?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: No, dad. I'm here to stop you.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Stop me? Impossible! Drilling has already begun. See for yourself.

nodes.title: The Prince Plot, Part Two
nodes.subtitle: Can you help Kim stop Silas Prince?

nodes.text: When we last left off, Mallika and Spike were trapped in the diamond mine beneath the Wilson High library...

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Which way was the door?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I don't know. It's so dark in here, I've gotten totally turned around.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Well, sitting down won't help.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I'm not sitting.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Wait... If you're not next to me, then who is...?
Spike flicks the switch on his MusicBoxx MP3 player. The tiny display projects a small beam of light, revealing...
...A HUMAN SKELETON!!!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: AAAAAAAHHH!!!

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: AAAAAAAHHH!!!
Mallika jumps back, colliding into Spike. They both topple over.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Spike, do you think Silas did that to... Whoever that is?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I doubt it. Look at his clothes. They're old-timey. And he has a pick with him.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Hey, do you think maybe that could be Obadiah Prince?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Silas did say he vanished without a trace. It's possible that Obadiah got stuck down here and couldn't find a way out.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: I hate to say it, but I know what that feels like. I'm not sure we're ever going to get out of here.
Just then, a sliver of light illuminates a nearby staircase.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Look, Spike! Someone opened the door.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Hey, are you guys okay?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Kim?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim!

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Whoa, guys. Chill out already.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Kim?! But...? How...?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Relax. We came to get you out of here.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Uh... 'We'?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Yes. That would be Kim...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: ...And `me.`

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Tom Prince?! But why?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Step aside, Kim. That jerk's father locked us in here. He's got exactly three seconds to...

nodes.prompt: He's got exactly three seconds to...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: What?!  Aren't you going to ask about my foot?

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Uh... No. Kim already said your foot was sore, but otherwise fine.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: I mean, you're holding down the gas pedal with it, aren't you?

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Sure, but it hurts. If Kim had been a little quicker, we'd be making better time on our way to the meeting of the Board of Directors.

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Oh, come on, man. Suck it up.

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Anyway, Kim, you were saying...

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Right, well, we didn't know it at the time, but Andy was right.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: We `were` being watched.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah. And I totally aced them!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: Touching that monitor just activated a security failsafe!

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: We need to get out of here now!
In fact, you were `perfect!` Enjoy your special bonus scene!
nodes.text_bbcode: In fact, you were [b]perfect![/b] Enjoy your special bonus scene!

nodes.text: Now that Centerscore has been saved from destruction, let's take a moment and check in around town...
First, we'll stop by the Soup Shack...

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: You kids all set?

nodes.speaker: Spike
nodes.text: Yeah, mom! This all looks great!

nodes.speaker: Mallika
nodes.text: Mm! Delicious!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Yes, Mrs. Chapman. We really appreciate it!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Well, it's the least we could do. You kids really saved all of our skins. So go ahead. Dig in!

nodes.speaker: Mrs. Chapman
nodes.text: Just make sure to save some for Kim and Phil!
Next, we'll drop by Kim's bakery...

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Wait, so that weird guy was actually Silas Prince's brother, and now Lucretia is in charge of Prince Automotive?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yep.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Sounds like you had a real adventure! Sorry I missed it.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Don't worry about it. I'd rather spend time alone with you anyway.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah. Oh... I nearly forgot. This was sitting by the door when I came in. I think it's a letter from Tom Prince.
Kim opens the envelope.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Well, what is it?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: It's a check!

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Yeah? For what?

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: The note just says, 'Keep the snickerdoodles coming'.

nodes.speaker: Phil
nodes.text: Huh... Maybe you were right. Maybe Tom Prince isn't such a bad guy, after all.

nodes.speaker: Kim
nodes.text: Yeah, I guess not. Anyway, let's head over to Soup Shack! They're all probably waiting on us to show up.
And at Prince Manor...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: It seems we've got more in common than I ever would've thought, Lucretia. Both of our fathers were monsters of one kind or another.

nodes.speaker: Lucretia
nodes.text: Yeah, but even so...

nodes.speaker: Tom
nodes.text: I know. I miss my dad, too.
Actually, that brings up a pretty good question. Whatever happened to Silas Prince and Mr. Doom?
A few months later, Silas Prince relaxes on an isolated South American beach...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: The Prince family empire may be in shambles, but I kept enough money off the books to keep me comfortable for the rest of my life.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Nothing but palm trees and coconuts from here on out.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: And speaking of comfortable... I'm starting to feel a little thirsty.
Silas enters a small beachside bodega...

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: That's odd. There doesn't seem to be anyone in here.

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: Hello? Is anyone there?
As Silas steps toward the backroom, a shadow rises up behind him.
Silas whips his head around!

nodes.speaker: Silas
nodes.text: No, not you! Not...

nodes.speaker: Mr. Doom
nodes.text: doooooooooom!
A few moments later, Mr. Doom emerges from the bodega. He wears Silas Prince's Hawaiian shirt and carries a frosty horchata.
A broad smile creeps across his pale, disfigured face.
Whoa! It looks like Silas Prince didn't get away with his crimes after all!
But did he get what he deserved? We'll let you decide.
